0022600200.text: The Celtics come in at 7-2 on a two-game winning streak, second in the East and one game back in the Atlantic, while the Bucks are 1-8, have lost five straight, and sit 15th in the East. Milwaukee will be without Gary Trent Jr., who is out with an illness. Boston leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after its 109-102 win in Boston on November 4, and it also won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
